notes.title: Draid Update
notes.notes:
Version v1.0.2 released

-Fixed cutscenes lighting problem

notes.title: Inaccessible World 2 bug fix
notes.notes:
It looks like some of the copies couldn't access the second world.
This problem is now fixed.
You may play now the second part and part 3 is coming this Friday as well.
Make sure to update your game with the latest update and we hope to hear from you more!

We are sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 0.2.1 and World 2 & 3 release schedule
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello to everyone![/h1]

After we received feedback, we have made some changes to the game, and it's systems for you to play better, faster, and smoother (The changes list will be at the bottom)

This Friday [b][u](Feb 8th)[/u][/b] we will release the second world, which will include five more themed levels, new enemies, new challenges, and new power.

[u][b]Feb 22nd[/b][/u] we plan on releasing the third world as well, so stay tuned for more information about that in our social accounts.
Twitter: [b]@evgeny_gutman[/b]
Instagram: [b]@bulletbears[/b]

Thank you for your time and feedback!


List of changes:
[list]
[*]Changed: the Camera system
[*]Changed: Player movement system
[*]Added: Bonus teleports at levels 2 & 4
[*]Added: Resolution refresh rate in the settings
[*]Added: Text above checkpoints and Finish flowers
[*]Fixed: Resolution duplicates showing
[*]Fixed: Some lighting cause extreme frame drops
[*]Fixed: Level 2 inside the tree is see through
[*]Fixed: Opening cutscene volume
[/list]
